answer: Hypothesis (natural-language answer): Interviews are the elicitation technique most commonly used by respondents for eliciting requirements in ML-enabled system projects. Among the 194 survey respondents who answered the Q9 elicitation block, 97 (50.0%, 95% percentile-bootstrap CI [42.8%, 57.2%], 10,000 resamples, seed 20240613) indicated using interviews — the highest of all five named techniques (Scenarios and Prototyping 38.7% each, Workshops and meetings 38.1%, Observation 33.0%). Interviews remain the most commonly used technique under every denominator convention tested (35.1% of all 276 rows with '-77' treated as non-use; 55.7% among respondents quoting at least one technique), so the ranking is robust. The exact quoted figure of 69.399% (95% CI [69.062, 69.735]) could not be regenerated from the supplied file: the shipped data has the original Likert response levels collapsed to a quoted/not-quoted encoding, under which the maximum reproducible proportion for any technique is 50.0%, and no natural statistic in the file equals 69.399% (the exact fraction 127/183 = 69.399% matches no count present). Its CI half-width (±0.34 pp) implies an effective sample of roughly 72,000, inconsistent with n≈194. This discrepancy is reported as an uncertainty rather than forced to fit; the data-grounded conclusion on the identity of the most commonly used technique — Interviews — is unaffected.

payload.hypothesis: Interviews are the elicitation technique most commonly used by respondents for eliciting requirements in ML-enabled system projects: 97 of 194 answering respondents (50.0%, 95% percentile-bootstrap CI [42.784%, 57.216%], 10,000 resamples) indicated using interviews, the highest proportion among the five named Q9 techniques (Scenarios 38.66%, Prototyping 38.66%, Workshops and meetings 38.14%, Observation 32.99%). The ranking is robust to denominator choice (35.145% of all 276 rows with '-77' as non-use; 55.747% among respondents quoting at least one technique). Note: the quoted 69.399% (95% CI [69.062, 69.735]) could not be regenerated from this transformed file (Likert levels collapsed to quoted/not-quoted; maximum reproducible proportion 50.0%; CI half-width implies effective n ≈ 72,000, inconsistent with n ≈ 194) and is reported as an unresolvable discrepancy.
payload.workflow: Loaded data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv (276 respondents, 202 columns). Identified Q9_ML_Elicitation_{Interviews, Scenarios, Prototyping, Workshops_Meetings, Observation, Others(+Free)} as the candidate elicitation items. Verified sentinels: '-77' marks unanswered Q9 items (identically the same 82 rows, all Status 'Suspended (22)' — survey dropouts) and was excluded; '-99'/'-66' are NA sentinels in free-text/numeric columns; free-text Others excluded from ranking. Computed quoted-proportions per technique under three labeled denominators (n=194 primary; n=276 robustness; n=174 quoters). Ran 10,000-resample percentile bootstrap (numpy default_rng, seed 20240613) over the 194 valid respondents for 95% CIs. Verified Interviews strictly highest point estimate. Attempted reconciliation with the quoted 69.399% figure and CI [69.062, 69.735]: no natural statistic in the file matches (exact fraction 127/183 = 69.399% has no corresponding count of 127; CI half-width implies n ≈ 72,049), reported as an uncertainty. Saved point estimates and bootstrap CIs to CSV.
